layout_note: No synthetic coordinates represented as anatomy.
selection: 384 largest traced cell-type/consensus-transmitter groups by neuron count, lexical tie break; no market inputs.
normalization: Top 32 incoming aggregate counts per target; signed outgoing transmitter convention; each nonzero absolute row sum scaled to 0.9.
sign_assumption: Acetylcholine +1; GABA, glutamate, histamine -1. Engineered convention; receptor-specific sign and neuromodulatory physiology are not modeled.
excluded: Untraced, untyped, unclear transmitter, and modulatory transmitter bodies; groups outside population-based top384.
attribution: FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), University of Cambridge, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, Google Research
